readerCopy.headline: A change you were ready for may finally become easy to make.
readerCopy.body:
Something that once felt disruptive may now have a clear opening. A different method is affordable enough to try. A schedule change is finally acceptable to everyone involved. A new idea arrives at the same moment you have enough information to use it instead of only talking about it.

Jupiter trine Uranus favors the change that solves a real problem. Use the opening while the cost of trying is low. You do not need to make the new version permanent before it has had a chance to live through an ordinary week.
